answer:
**Where it's opened**
- `GameConsoleComponent.openInventory()` at `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237` opens it with `this.dialog.open(InventoryComponent, …)`.
- The "Inventory" button in `game-console.component.html` (line ~9) triggers it through `(click)="openInventory()"`.
- The dialog options are `panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel'` and `maxHeight: '90vh'`.

**Data passed**
- The dialog receives `InventoryDialogData` (`inventory.component.ts:19`), which has two fields:
  - `characterId: this.characterId`
  - `sessionId: this.sessionId`
- `InventoryComponent` reads it through `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.
- Only `characterId` is used. `sessionId` is never read.
- The dialog gets the character and inventory state from `CharacterStateService`, not from the dialog data. `character = this.charSvc.character`.
- The `afterClosed()` handler in `openInventory()` is an empty subscription containing only a comment.

**API calls it can make**
All go through `GameApiService` (`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`) to Worker routes in `worker/src/routes/character.ts`.

| Trigger | Method in `InventoryComponent` | Service method | HTTP request | Worker route |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dialog init | `loadInventory()` | `getInventory` | `GET /api/character/:id`, which returns the full character payload; only `.inventory` is used | `characterRoutes.get('/:id')` (line 72) |
| Equip / unequip | `toggleEquip()` | `equipItem` | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` with `{ itemId, equipped }` | `characterRoutes.patch('/:id/equip')` (line 93) |
| Drop | `dropItem()` | `dropItem` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` | `characterRoutes.delete('/:id/inventory/:itemId')` (line 137) |
| Use potion | `usePotion()` | `dropItem` | The same `DELETE` as drop | Same as drop |

**Things to know**
- **Potion use has no dedicated endpoint.** `usePotion()` rolls the heal dice client-side from `item.effect.heal`. It then calls the drop `DELETE` to consume the item.
- **Healing is client-side only.** The new HP is applied only in the client through `charSvc.setCharacter()`. It is never sent to the server.
- **Shop calls are not part of this dialog.** The shop endpoints (`/api/shop/...`) are used elsewhere.
